body.p: Redundancy servers are often used to create high-availability environments. In simpler terms, you create a second server deployment, called redundancy servers, that takes over if the production servers fail, helping to avoid downtime.

p.note: A redundancy environment requires a special redundancy license key. To obtain one, contact our sales department at sales@oxygenxml.com.

body.p: To achieve this, you need to create two environments:

ul.li: Redundancy - A secondary environment that takes over if the production environment fails.

body.p: Each environment consists of two components: an HTTP License Server and a Web Author instance.

ol.li: Install an instance of the Oxygen HTTP License Server for each environment.

Configure each license server to use the appropriate license key. Configure the production license key on the license server in the production environment, and configure the redundancy license key on the license server in the redundancy environment.
Install a Web Author instance for each environment. Choose Flexible setup on the initial configuration page.

Go to the Administration page and configure both Web Author instances to use the license server instances:
The production license server as the main server.
The redundancy license server as the backup server.Both Web Author instances use the same license server configuration.
If only the production license server fails, Web Author automatically switches to the backup license server in the redundancy environment.

body.p: For the instance in the redundancy environment to replace the one in production, you need to set up a load balancer that directs users to the Web Author instance in the redundancy environment only when the production environment is down.
For an example of a Docker-based load balancer configuration in the public GitHub repository, see: .

p.note: Only the Web Author instances need to be handled by the load balancer because fallback for License Server connections is automatically handled by each Web Author instance if the main License Server fails.
